rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are Eisenhower letters that move from an explanation of a national economic problem to establishment of a Cabinet Committee, request the addressee to serve as chairman, designate named Cabinet-level members by copies of the letter, permit cooperation or participation by other agencies, and charge the committee with preparing recommendations. C14 and C24 use closely related Cabinet-committee machinery, but C03 most closely matches the child's language and sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: To this end I am establishing a Cabinet Committee on Small Business of which I would like you to serve as Chairman.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To point the way to the solution of this wide range of problems, I am establishing a Cabinet Committee... I am requesting you to serve as Chairman of the Committee.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel transition, committee establishment, and appointment of the letter's addressee as chairman.

shared_material.child_excerpt: By copies of this letter I am designating the Secretaries of Defense, Commerce, Labor, the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization... as Members.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: By copy of this letter, I am designating the Secretary of State, the Secretary of Commerce and the Director of the Office of Defense Mobilization to serve as the other members.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical mechanism and phrasing for constituting the committee through copies of the chairman's letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Other department and agency heads will participate on an ad hoc basis as may be deemed desirable. The Committee is to have the continuing assignment of making specific recommendations to me...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I suggest that this Committee work in close cooperation with the Bureau of the Budget, the Department of the Treasury and such other departments and agencies... The task will be the preparation of recommendations for consideration by myself and the Cabinet.
shared_material.explanation: Both supplement a small Cabinet committee with other governmental participants and define its central function as developing recommendations for presidential consideration.
